title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Terms Table: Refund Window, Admin Fee, Transfers and Expiry Extensions
content:
Tailwise Grooming Salon passes differ in how they may be refunded, moved to another pet or extended. The figures per pass:

| Pass | Full-refund window after purchase | Refund admin fee (USD) | Visits may move to another pet of the same customer | One-time expiry extension offered | Length of the extension |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 14 calendar days | 10.00 | no | no | 0 days |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 14 calendar days | 10.00 | yes | yes | 60 days |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 14 calendar days | 15.00 | yes | yes | 60 days |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 14 calendar days | 15.00 | yes | yes | 90 days |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 14 calendar days | 15.00 | yes | yes | 90 days |
| Groom Club Monthly | 0 days | 0.00 | no | no | 0 days |

**Definitions**

- *Full-refund window* — the calendar days after purchase within which an unused pass is refunded in full.
- *Refund admin fee* — the fee withheld from a partial refund after the full-refund window.
- *Visits may move* — whether the remaining visits may be moved to another pet of the same customer.
- *Expiry extension* — whether a one-time extension of the expiry date may be granted on request before expiry, and how many days it adds.

**Side-by-side (hypothetical)**

- A Full Groom Pass 6-Visit and a Full Groom Pass 4-Visit carry the same 15.00 admin fee, but the 6-visit pass extends by 90 days and the 4-visit pass by 60.
- The Express Bath Pass 3-Visit offers neither a transfer nor an extension; its admin fee is 10.00.
